Amathiphu Okupheka Uphuthu:
• Sebenzisa isilinganiso esifanele: Hlanganisa ingxenye eyodwa yomgqomo wempuphu yezimbeleko nezengxenye ezintathu zamanzi ukuze uthole uphuthu othambile.
• Bilisa amanzi kuqala: Bilisa amanzi ngaphambi kokufaka impuphu kancane kancane.
• Hlanganisa njalo: Xuba ngenkathi ufaka impuphu ukuze ugweme amahlule.
• Pheka kancane: Pheka ngomlilo ophansi imizuzu engu-20 kuya kwengu-30, uvuse ngezikhathi.
• Ngeza ukunambitheka: Faka usawoti omncane noma ibhotela ukuze uthuthukise ukunambitheka.

Amathiphu Okupheka Isaladi Enempilo:
• Qala ngezinto eziluhlaza: Sebenzisa isipinashi noma ikale njengezisekelo ezinempilo.
• Faka amaprotheni alula: Faka inyama yenkukhu etshisiwe, i-tofu noma u-salmon.
• Faka amafutha anempilo: Faka i-avocado, amantongomane noma uwoyela we-olive.
• Hlanganisa izinhlobo ezahlukene: Xuba imifino eqinile (ikukhamba, ikhapisi) nezithambile (itamatisi, i-avocado).
• Faka isidakamizwa esilula: Sebenzisa i-vinaigrette eyenziwe ekhaya ngelamula no-olive oil ukuze wehlise ushukela nosawoti.

Amathiphu Okulungisa Amapastry Amahle:
• Gcina izithako zibanda: Beka ibhotela namanzi efrijini ukuze uthole ipastry elithambile.
• Ungawusebenzi kakhulu umgqomo: Xuba kancane ukuze ugweme ipastry eqinile.
• Sebenzisa ufulawa kancane: Fafaza kancane ukuze ungashintshi ukuma komgqomo.
• Phumisa umgqomo: Beka efrijini imizuzu engu-30 ukuze uphumule futhi uthambe.
• Qengqa ngokulinganayo: Sebenzisa ingcindezi efanayo ukuze uthole ubukhulu obufanayo.

Amathiphu Ezidlo Ezimnandi:
• Linganisa ubumnandi: Hlola ushukela futhi wehlise uma kudingeka.
• Sebenzisa izithako ezintsha: Izithelo ezintsha noma ushokoledi osezingeni eliphezulu kuyathuthukisa ukunambitheka.
• Beka umgqomo efrijini: Lokhu kuthuthukisa ukwakheka nokwenza kube lula ukusebenza.
• Lawula izinga lokushisa lehhavini: Pheka kahle ukuze ungashi noma ungaphothuli.
• Hlobisa ngobuciko: Faka izimbali ezidliwayo, amantongomane noma ushukela othuliwe ukuze kube muhle.

Amathiphu Wokwenza AmaBurger Anempilo:
• Khetha inyama enama-protein alula: Sebenzisa inyama yenkukhu noma inyama yenkomo enosawoti omncane.
• Faka imifino: Hlanganisa i-zucchini noma amakhowe aqoshiwe kumapatty.
• Sebenzisa ama-bun enempilo: Khetha ama-bun e-wheat noma e-multigrain.
• Tshisa noma pheka: Sebenzisa i-grill noma i-oveni ukuze wehlise uwoyela.
• Faka izithako ezintsha: Faka letisi, itamatisi, i-avocado kanye ne-anyanisi ukuze kuthuthukise ukunambitheka.
